recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you. Thank you, Mr. President, and Senator Mayer. It's interesting, when people hear the term Regents, they assume it's an exam. But it's not. It's much more than that. There are 17 people with the title Regent, and we are electing eight of them today. But the Regents, interestingly, are -- they go back to our colonial period. And I love to cite one of the most famous Regents was Alexander…
